name: Elgron Compatibility Patches
description:
Compatibility patches for Elgron.

Supported mods:
• cetatea-town
• courtyard-town
• preserve-town
• retreat-town
• third-upgrades + wake-of-gods.level8Units (Darkness Dragon)

You can safely enable any number of sub-patches at the same time.
author: Kay
